target.name: Unone spatial arrays and cost diagnostics
target.scope: Public SDK generic typed JSON-array publication and spatial CPU authoring/cost diagnostics; supplementary informed actual native GPU and fresh WASM CPU/WebGPU main/Worker regression. Excludes gameplay, renderer appearance, speedup/threshold benchmark, device-loss and cross-device certification.
target.revision: checkout7b9424cf42d0409633c9ce782503075bd09018f9 with preserved concurrent dirty changes; SDK CLI SHA2564fedf99a941c82009272f2ef4315fe809648e4a216d0043408f4331c7a55f180; selected hashes identify bounded inputs.
target.environment: Windows x64; preinstalled toolchains; NVIDIA GeForce RTX5080 native Vulkan, Edge155.0.4283.62 WebGPU; new release SDK and hash-verified WASM. Audit started2026-10-23 and completed2026-10-24 Asia/Taipei; no game edits/install/commit/push.

limitations: Aggregate is informed/retest; only the separately sealed SDK author is fresh-context/blind. Owner source review, regression tests and replay are not blind authorship.

Trial steps are39 recorded author subprocess operations,24 public CLI plus2 nested replay CLI. Zero unsupported API/flag guesses; one natural-language search miss, one Node inspection helper syntax failure and one Luau query-literal widening error are retained. Four deliberate API negatives are separate.

First strict attempt029 failed. Native delivery030 occurred before repair and is not represented as strict-checked. Typed local repair031, strict success032, final run033, independent JSON verification035/036 and fresh-temp replay038 are retained in order.

Owner capture-blind-replay.json failed a CRLF-versus-LF canonical-block assertion. The byte-normalized content was independently verified equal; only the wrapper was repaired and actually rerun as capture-blind-replay-v2.json with the same subject set. Failed capture and original probe remain unchanged.
The author used only public SDK/docs/CLI, actual CPU and the external official analyzer. GPU is explicitly untested by that author; actual native/WebGPU checks here are separate informed regressions.
Native GPU integration is a cold2body4query case;4096x128 is the informed SDK/WASM case;4096x256 is the blind CPU case. They are not a backend speed comparison.

Unmeasured GPU kernel time is nil in Luau/null in host JSON with an explicit reason. Host phases may overlap/nest; do not sum them or relabel readback wait as kernel duration. Timings exclude Luau/bridge/caller application/setup.

Publishing wall-clock profile values intentionally makes those observations nondeterministic. Digest equality is asserted only for control versus profile-read-only runs with no diagnostic publication.

All files read by each small probe wrapper are selected in the same44-subject set, including sealed final fixture inputs and oracle. Executable/analyzer/WASM files are pinned by explicit binary/manifest hashes rather than exceeding the recorder2MiB subject limit.

Selected source fingerprints are not immutable source copies or a full compiler dependency graph; only blind evidence has a detached manifest seal. Local hashes do not certify authorship or a clean source-to-binary build.

The10 questions cover this declared scope, not the whole engine. The changed SDK/task scope is not a formal numeric before/after comparison with previous audits, and no renderer, universal speedup or cross-device safety certification is claimed.

value.meaning: 固定 rubric 的證據支持分數（0–100 下限），不是普遍有效的 AI-native 認證。未驗證項未從分母移除。

dimensions.title: 用途與起點
dimensions.question: 陌生 AI 從入口能否說明工具解決什麼、不解決什麼，以及下一個正確操作？
dimensions.answer: A fresh SDK-only author found the linked generic geometry guide, used canonical types and preserved caller-owned movement/application policy.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain the SDK guide links and engine/caller ownership boundary.

dimensions.title: 能力與限制發現
dimensions.question: 如何查到目前版本真正可用的功能、相依條件與未實作能力，而不是猜 API？
dimensions.answer: Public search/descriptors expose array/setArray, spatial query limits and profile semantics, with the complete guide/types inside the actual new SDK.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep public descriptors, complete packaged docs and canonical types synchronized.

dimensions.title: 可執行操作契約
dimensions.question: 只靠可發現的契約及最小例子能否完成代表任務？輸入欄位、回傳及副作用是否明確？
dimensions.answer: The fresh author independently implemented typed numeric/record publication, nearest/overlap/sweep, invalid replacement and repair, next-tick delivery and ticket/index boundaries through public APIs.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain failed029, original/final scripts and replay; use another fresh author after future contract changes.

dimensions.title: 上下文與需求真相
dimensions.question: 是否保留 ID、關聯、版本、來源與待決事項？AI 能否取得必要脈絡而不把推測當需求？
dimensions.answer: Ticket/version records distinguish frozen version1 work from repaired version2 work; rejected replacement preserves the original body geometry and unrelated entity.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep snapshot/version/lifetime contracts explicit without implying save persistence.

dimensions.title: 結果與狀態觀察
dimensions.question: 如何查到實際變更、進度、完成、失敗與限制？是否把已送出、執行成功、人類驗收分開？
dimensions.answer: Canonical complete results/info/profile publish directly. Empty query results and no-contact hits remain JSON[], authored typed numeric/record/empty/nested arrays work, and plain{} stays an object.
dimensions.nextAction: Preserve generic marker validation, array/object distinction and read-only digest regressions.

dimensions.title: 具體錯因與修復
dimensions.question: 故意做錯一次：回應是否指出錯誤碼、欄位或物件、實際值與預期、具體原因及可採取的修復？修正後重跑是否成功？
dimensions.answer: Duplicate bodyID11 identifies the invalid replacement; same-tick, consumed-ticket and destroyed-index calls expose stable spatial error codes. The corrected replacement and later delivery succeed.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain actionable codes and repair examples; consider structured field diagnostics only as a separate generic extension.

dimensions.title: 重試、衝突與恢復
dimensions.question: 重複請求、狀態過時、失去回覆或中斷時，AI 能否判斷安全重試、續接或需人類介入，不重複副作用？
dimensions.answer: Caught early take leaves the ticket usable next tick; rejected replacement preserves version1, repair produces version2, and consumed or destroyed resources reject reuse safely.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep validation rejection distinct from terminal execution faults; add device interruption tests when that scope is requested.

dimensions.title: 權限與作用範圍
dimensions.question: 讀寫、目標專案／裝置、批准與外部副作用是否可查且實際受到限制？以一個越界操作驗證。
dimensions.answer: Only local synthetic fixtures and reusable engine APIs are used. Same-tick access, consumed-ticket reuse and destroyed-index submission are rejected; the unrelated scene entity remains unchanged.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep geometry queries independent of game movement, targeting policy and hit responses.

dimensions.title: 效能與成本定位
dimensions.question: 能否觀察這類工具相關的耗時、資源或成本及瓶頸？無法量測是否明說而不回傳假零？不要求每種工具都有 GPU 指標。
dimensions.answer: Public spatial.profile exposes bounded work counts, equivalent input bytes, transfer bytes, manager timings and executor host phases. Missing GPU kernel time has an explicit reason, not a fabricated zero.
dimensions.nextAction: Use representative application measurements before selecting thresholds; retain exclusions, overlap semantics and unavailability reasons.

dimensions.title: 版本與可重現驗證
dimensions.question: 能否保留版本指紋、環境、輸入、輸出及可重跑步驟？如何知道修改後原失敗案例確實已修复？
dimensions.answer: All five actual recorder executions share44 selected input hashes, verify current probe hashes and complete without source changes/truncation/timeouts. The126-file blind seal and pinned SDK/analyzer/runtime identities are retained.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain this evidence unchanged; create a new audit directory and fresh author for future first-use claims.
